table.retrieve:
SELECT 
		itemname= case item.printable WHEN 1 THEN item.name ELSE 'Counter Sale:'+LTRIM(RTRIM(item.customicode)) END, 
		manf=(select name from manufacturer  where manufacturer.manfcode=item.manfcode),	
		
		/*issuedate=(select max(date) from issuedetail,issueheader  where issueheader.issueinvcode=issuedetail.issueinvcode and issuedetail.issrowid=saledetail.issuerowid),*/
		specialinstructions=customer.specialinstructions,  
		 aliasname=item.customicode,   
         packingdesc=item.packingdesc,   
         accname = dbo.accounts.name,  
		custalias=accounts.aliasname, 
         address = dbo.customer.address1,   
         address2= dbo.customer.address2,    
         salesman = dbo.users.username,   
         quotationcode = saleledger.quotationcode,   
         headerno = saleledger.headerno,   
         date = saleledger.date,   
         invdiscperc = saleledger.discperc,   
         misccharges = saleledger.misccharges,   
         flatdisc = saleledger.flatdisc,   
         invsalestax = saleledger.salestax,   
         gcode = saledetail.gcode,   
         icode = saledetail.icode,   
         looseqty = saledetail.qty,   
         bonusqty = saledetail.bonusqty,   
   
         packunits= saledetail.packunits,   
         saleprice= saledetail.saleprice,   
         discperc = saledetail.discperc,  
			itemflatdisc=saledetail.itemflatdisc,   
 
         Id = saledetail.IDENTITYCOL,   
         posted=saleledger.posted,   
         balance=0,   
         unitsalestax = saledetail.unitsalestax,   
         gstperc = saledetail.gstperc,   
         invgstperc = saleledger.invgstperc1,   
         custTaxRegno=customer.salestaxregno  ,
			saleledger.custrefno,	
			saleledger.remarks,

			remarks2=saleledger.remarks2,
			remarks3=saleledger.remarks3,
			remarks4=saleledger.remarks4,
			remarks5=saleledger.remarks5,

			remarks6=saleledger.remarks6,
			remarks7=saleledger.remarks7,
			remarks8=saleledger.remarks8,
			remarks9=saleledger.remarks9,
			serverdate=getdate(),
			custcode=saleledger.custcode,
			salesperson=(select name from salesman where salesmancode=saleledger.smancode),
			messages=(select description from message where messagecode=saleledger.messagecode),
			notes = (SELECT NT.Notes FROM View_ItemNotes NT WHERE NT.ICode = item.Icode)


    FROM quotationheader saleledger,   
        quotationdetail saledetail,   
         accounts,   
         customer,   
         users,   
         item  

   WHERE ( saleledger.quotationcode = :ar_quotationcode ) AND  
         ( saleledger.quotationcode = saledetail.quotationcode) AND  
         ( saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
         ( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
         ( saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND  
         ( saledetail.icode = dbo.item.icode)    

ORDER BY /*dbo.item.customicode,*/
			saledetail.quotationcode,
			saledetail.IDENTITYCOL

objects.name: c_sumsalestaxval
objects.expression: /* sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for group 1) */

objects.name: c_totaltax
objects.expression: /* Round(Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) ,2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2) + sum(c_salestaxval for group 1) , 0) */
